summary: Implemented the unregistered dependency-injected POST /api/cases/analyze router factory. It validates the formal request contract, preserves request IDs, forwards case_id/evaluation_time/challenge_mode/case_input to AnalyzeService, returns a single envelope shape, maps safe service failures, and enforces a maximum 20-second boundary. No main registration or live-model invocation was added.

acceptance_results.criterion: case_id-only transport, formal request schema negatives, Challenge gating, safe model failures, timeout, and repeated delegated analysis
same absolute isolated interpreter and healthy dependency graph

acceptance_results.evidence: Verifier-owned artifact is forbidden and was not written

remaining_risks: The router factory is intentionally unregistered; a separately authorized composition batch must inject the concrete service and include the route.
ASGI tests use labelled transport doubles; no real model/provider request was attempted or claimed.
Independent verification and coordinator integration receipt remain required.
handoff_notes: Import create_analyze_router from covenia_b.api.analyze and inject an AnalyzeService in a separately authorized main-wiring change. The router preserves model_metadata.cached_result provenance through the frozen service response and does not maintain its own cache or historical state.
